description: Takes one process as 2-20 steps and returns per step whether it is handled by code (MCP/API), by a model (and on which route) or by a person, whether a redaction gate comes first and whether human approval is needed. Fixed rule table from the published method; no model is called. A preview of what the Information Flow Mapping Session does with your team, not a design. Describe steps in general words; no personal data.

lang.description: Language of the answer: en (English, default) or nl (Dutch).

process_name.description: Short name of the process in general words (3-160 characters). No personal data.

steps.description: The steps of the process in order, 2 to 20. Each step is routed to code, a model or a person.

external_effect.description: true when the step pays, rejects, books or sends something outside the organisation; a step not taken by a person then needs human approval. Default false.

kind.description: What the step does. Handled by code: fetch_record, calculate, write_record, notify. Handled by a model: classify, extract, summarise, draft_text (Route A candidate), judge_edge_case (Route B candidate). Handled by a person: decide.

name.description: What happens in this step, in general words (2-120 characters). No personal data.

personal_data.description: true when the step handles personal data; for a model step a redaction gate then comes first. Default false.

name: scope_mapping_session
title: Routing preview for one process
